notes.title: Godking Released!
notes.content:
It’s been an intense five months of early access and at times we worried we would not get this far. The amazing support from the community has been a key element, and we want to thank everyone for helping us get here.

This update adds many finishing touches to the game, and fixes a few long standing issues we wanted done before release.

Hope you are enjoying the game, and remember to find us on Discord!


[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Added AI difficulty settings when starting a new game. On Footman setting the AI player gets no bonuses, while Knight gives +50% and Lord gives +100% resource income bonus. The Lord difficulty setting will challenge even veteran players.

[*] Added option to show only direct units under a commander on the Manage Armies screen. This is a tick box that makes it a lot easier to instantly see who commands who.

[*] Added beautified unit icons to the game with formation and rank information. This makes it easy to at a glance identify units. These changes affect Manage Armies as well as Faction Select and Holding Recruitment UI.

[*] Added improved minimap with easier to read holding ownership coloring. We also dimmed the biome colors somewhat to make the political information stand out.

[*] Added increased range for most catapults and siege weapons to make them more useful in very large armies.

[*] Added improved godrays for faction HQs and armies, making them prettier and less noisy.

[*] Added several missing tooltips across the game.

[*] Updated the ingame encyclopedia with improved texts and screenshots.
[/list]


[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with tooltips not displaying the correct movement cost for armies with movement traits, such as Forest Walker or Swamp Expert.

[*] Fixed several smaller UI issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Godking Update - AI Aggression & Release Info
notes.content:
This update focuses on huge improvements to AI players, making them a lot more challenging to play against. They will now aggressively invade enemy territory and search for HQs to conquer with big armies.

We are excited to hear what you think about our new AI!

Godking has been in early access for almost five months. The game has come a long way and can hardly be recognized since EA started back in April. Our primary stretch goal during early access was to get to a stage where we could add multiplayer features to the game. We have unfortunately been unable to reach this milestone, and Godking will be released as a singleplayer game September 16th.

To reflect this change and as of today, the price of the game has been reduced. The new price might give more players a chance to check out Godking. 

If all goes to plan our next patch will be our release build. It will feature the introduction of AI difficulty levels and a host of final polishing touches and upgrades across the game.

As we are getting out of early access we want to thank our amazing community for all your help and support along the way. It has been an absolute blast and we have made a ton of new friends.

We are extremely grateful!


[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Added almost completely rewritten AI to the game. This update makes them competent opponents that will scout and invade enemy territory and aggressively go after enemy HQs they find. This is a massive power boost for the AI and makes the game more fun for veteran players.

[*] Added improved strategic layer for AI players, making them more effective when using summoning rituals and recruiting units for their armies. AI players will now also use multiple smaller scouting armies to keep their borders safe and to harass enemies.

[*] Added impact special effects for spells and attacks, as well as many new combat animations for humanoid units in the game. This makes combat even cooler to watch.

[*] Added faction shields with colors and faction symbols for Blackbog Goblins and Mercia.

[*] Added option to turn off walk animations for commanders and armies on the world map. This feature has been requested by many in our community, so we are happy to finally get it added to the game.

[*] Added new sound and special effects when summoning units using ritual spells or when combat summoning for all factions.

[*] Added refresh when moving units between garrison and armies on holding UI.

[*] Added optimized shadows for parts of the game, making it run slightly smoother on older hardware.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with catapults and some siege weapons causing a NullRef error message.

[*] Fixed a key not found exception.

[*] Fixed an issue where ritual spells set to auto-cast were not being saved properly.

[*] Fixed an issue where AI players could end up having the same faction color as other AI players.

[*] Fixed an issue with the combat playback speed drop down menu UI being hard to use.

[*] Fixed many smaller animation issues on numerous units.
[/list]

notes.title: Godking Update - Deep Dweller
notes.content:
Hi everyone - This patch we added more customization of matches, allowing players to set which enemy factions and incarnations to fight. We also added several AI upgrades and a new tutorial section to the game.

We updated our store trailer recently, as the game has come a long way since it was made around EA release in April. Make sure to check it out if you haven’t already.

Our current focus is on improving the AI, making them more challenging to defeat.

We hope you are enjoying Godking. Feel free to join us on Discord to chat about the game!

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Added game customization screen, allowing you to set enemy AI factions and Incarnations before starting a new game.

[*] Added How To Play quick tutorial section for new players on the main menu. This is a series of screenshots with annotations explaining the game.

[*] Added understanding of scouting and harassing for AI players. They now actively scout for enemy holdings and HQs with cheaper units, and invade and harass enemy territory and undefended assets more aggressively than before.

[*] Added improved pathfinding for AI players, making them better at expanding and chasing down enemy armies more optimally.

[*] Added impact special effects and sounds for spells and attacks during combat. We feel this takes combat to a new level, and are eager to hear what you think.
[/list]

[u]Content[/u]
[list]
[*] Added Scaleborne holding upgrade Altar of Frost. This gives access to Deep Dweller units for recruitment at the Scaleborg.

[*] Adjusted the size of several bigger monsters on the world map, as some dragons and giant monsters were hilariously oversized.

[*] Added dozens of new spell, movement and attack sounds for combat.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Updated Godking to the latest version of Unity. We think this may fix some smaller issues and generally improve performance for most players.

[*] Fixed an issue where players could get a notification of AI transforming or upgrading units, during enemy turn.

[*] Fixed a rare issue that could cause AI armies to get stuck in a pathfinding loop.

[*] Several Alfendor and elven units had shields but were missing their block traits.
[/list]

notes.title: Godking Update - New faction - Alfendor
notes.content:
We are back with a new update featuring a complete overhaul of the world map and the new playable elven faction Alfendor joins the game!


[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Added totally revamped world map UI - Powerscores and unit counts are now both shown directly on the world map and holdings have icons indicating recruitment or upgrade options as well as defenses. This makes it a lot easier to read the world map without having to rely on tooltips.

[*] Added new world map fog of war and unexplored terrain special effects. This beautified the world map dramatically and has made it feel more interesting to explore.

[*] Added faction colors and symbols to Alfendor unit shields. This looks really cool on the battlefield, so we will roll this out to other factions over time.

[*] Added new mouse cursor to the game, replacing the old with a Godking themed and stylized version.

[*] Added resource income tooltip stacking, making it easier to read income tooltip in the very late game.

[*] Added experimental edge of screen scrolling for the world map. This is an unfinished feature that can be turned on under options for anyone interested in an early look.
[/list]

[u]Content[/u]
[list]
[*] Added faction number eight to Godking - Alfendor is a faction of nature and life aligned elves, and comes with 40 new faction specific units and the most holding upgrades so far. They start the game slow, but if they get a good economy going while building out the Forest Castle, it is hard to stop them.

[*] New Incarnation Jaden Lightmaid - The new elven themed incarnation joins the game. She is a great healer mounted on a sacred Jaden Suntiger and can call on elven warriors to aid her in combat. She can summon guinian killer penguins and craft mighty undying and regenerating umberhulks.

[*] Several units from the Daughters of Gaia minor NPC faction had shields but were missing their block traits. Gaian Vanguard, Gaian Shieldmaid and Gaian Lancemaid will now correctly start blocking incoming attacks.

[*] Mercian ritual Promote Archer has been made much cheaper, now only costing two food to perform.

[*] Minor NPC faction Quanta, a dangerous group of interdimensional invaders, have shields but were missing their block traits. Heads up as they are now more difficult to deal with.

[*] Alfendor can recruit guinians at Holy Grove, Sacred Henge, Mana Well, Mana Spring and Secret Garden.

[*] Added many new random encounters to the game, some will join Alfendor.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where selecting and then deselecting the faction HQ would take you back to the HQ again through the player action bar.

[*] Fixed an issue where saving a game would not correctly save the name of faction HQ.

[*] Fixed an issue causing an error message to appear for The Returned when using a trading station. 

[*] Fixed an issue on the Manage Armies UI, where dragging and dropping an artifact on a unit would not correctly show the change in stats and powerscore instantly on the unit card.

[*] Fixed an issue where pressing shortcut ‘r’ to open Manage Armies while the Holding UI was open, did not work correctly.

[*] Fixed numerous smaller bugs and lore description issues, many based on community feedback - thanks a ton to all that helped!
[/list]

notes.title: Godking Update - Mountain Giants
notes.content:
[i]Our ambition with Godking is to make it the best 4X fantasy strategy game it can possibly be. We plan to get there by constantly expanding and building it, not slowing down.

Feedback and reviews have been extremely positive so far, and for that we are humbled and grateful. We read all feedback more than once and we turn your comments into actionable tasks when we can.

We have gotten enough wishlist additions to invade a small country, but could use more help getting the word around. If you like the game, please tell someone - If you don’t like it, please tell us :)

Have fun crushing enemy armies and look out for mountain giants![/i]


[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] New Manage Armies UI - The new Manage Armies UI visualizes units and artifacts as they appear on the battlefield, and makes it a lot easier to understand how to compose effective armies. We are really happy with it and it opens up interesting options for the future.

[*] Added embedding of commanders - The ability to embed a commander under another commander has been implemented under the Manage Armies UI. This removes a commander from the world map and turns it into a regular unit. To make it a commander again, drag it out onto command position in the Manage Armies UI.

[*] Added banners and flags on holding defenses - We have added gorgeous banners, torches and flags on all walled holding defenses. These banners show faction colors and symbols on the battlemap and look super cool!

[*] Huge combat sound update - added dozens of attacks, movement, spell effects and dying sounds for most units in the game. This enhances combat dramatically, and makes it more exciting to watch on lower playback speeds.

[*] Scrying spells - We have added several new scrying ritual spells to the game. With these you can target an area and gain map information from safety.

[*] Scalable UI - Implemented up/down scaling for the UI. You will find the slider to adjust it under options.

[*] Added finalized battlemap music tracks, including an especially epic song for HQ battles. This track will only play during faction HQ battles.

[*] Added godray highlights for faction HQs to make them stand out more on the world map.

[*] Added overhead notifications for ritual spell summons on the world map, to make it easier to see at a glance what was summoned. This is especially useful if you have turned off summon visualizations under options.

[*] Setting ritual spells to auto-cast is now done by ctrl+right click. The tooltip has been updated to reflect this change.
[/list]

[u]Content[/u]
[list]
[*] Godking has been played by many of our favorite youtubers already. In celebration we added 10 new artifacts to the game. Lucid Headband, Explorminatus Spyglass, Nookrium Experience, Sampstra's Finger Band, Sergiu's Hellish Amulet, Winter Mittens of Toryn, Lovers Turn, Anhad's Insight, Shoes of Sabouts, Throneful Knife and Spear of Reinos will start showing up in new games.

[*] Added Scaleborne holding upgrade Hatchery Expansion which gives +1 recruitment per turn.

[*] Added Scaleborne Darkscale Vanger - an elite defensive frontline unit. It is unlocked by getting the new upgrade Vanguards Temple at the Scaleborg.

[*] Earthmother gained new ritual spell Eyes of Nature. A powerful scrying spell with massive range.

[*] Mercia gained ritual spell Expose Enemies. This is a fire themed scrying spell with a lingering effect. It can also be found on recruitable Invoker commanders at Magic Libraries and Academies.

[*] Added minor NPC faction Orken. They are a remnant from early Eliador, when roaming ork tribe hordes dominated the world. They can appear as holding defenders and world encounters.

[*] There is now a higher chance that Farms have no defenders when a new game starts.

[*] Added new holding Mountain Fortress to the game. These are well defended and have recruitment options. They are uncommon and may not show up in all playthroughs.

[*] Added Mountain Giant to the game. These big guys can be recruited at the Mountain Fortress holding by factions using food as a resource. They can also appear as super rare random encounters. They are strong and can be used as soloing super combatants, cleaning up wandering monsters on their own.

[*] Ogres can now be recruited by all factions with access to gold and food on their world holdings.
[/list]

[u]Balance[/u]
[list]
[*] High Shaman ritual Summon Wolven Fenrir cost increased from sacred herbs 34 to 38. It still remains one of the strongest summons in the game, but now slightly more expensive to amass them.

[*] Blackbog Dark Queen ritual spell Slavecraft Mastery herb cost increased from 10 to 18. This is still perhaps the best value frontline summon in the game right now.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where spellcasters could affect allied units with negative effects, including fear and enslave. Friendly units are now immune to most negative conditions causing spells.

[*] Fixed an issue where moving a consumable artifact from a non-commander to a commander, would not correctly refresh active select UI instantly with the new information.

[*] Fixed an issue where undefended independent holdings would sometimes show a player faction symbol instead of the independent symbol.

[*] Fixed a rare reappearing issue where a commander could become invisible on the world map until you cycled to him with the arrow keys or reloaded the game. Hopefully now we got this one for good!

[*] Fixed an issue causing AI players to sometimes not pull all their armies into the fight even if they could, when their HQ was attacked.

[*] Fixed an issue causing AI players to leave behind friendly encounter commanders joining them.

[*] Fixed an issue causing AI players to underspend on resources, when they could have up to much bigger armies that they had. This has made it considerably harder to eliminate AI players.

[*] Fixed an issue where artifacts could cause negative stat values.

[*] Fixed a large amount of minor technical and visual issues, generally cleaning up and polishing the game.
[/list]

notes.title: Godking Patch - Banshee Queen
notes.content:
[i]This update adds the Banshee Queen incarnation to the game and introduces world construction, including settling/building of new holdings and transformation of existing ones with spells.

More world construction and alteration content will be added gradually over the coming weeks.

AI is our primary focus at the moment and is progressing well. It is now harder to banish them, as they have gotten better at both defending their territories and composing more effective armies.

Our next AI step is to teach them more ways to invade enemy territory and we are working towards more customization of matches and opponents.

Improving the UI is another big focus and we are implementing an upgrade for our Manage Armies UI next patch.[/i]


[u]Content[/u]

[list]
[*] Added new Incarnation Banshee Queen. This ghostly lady can summon different ethereal units to help her and she has the trait Incorporeal which makes her immune to all non-magical attacks. With careful target selection she can be a fantastic early game solo expander, and comes with Ghost Dragon and Ghost Dog scouting/harass options.

[*] Khaoset got a visual lift, making it easier to differentiate the various units from each other both in combat and on unit icons. Khaoset units are now also proudly displaying their faction colors.

[*] Panzerbears will now sell their services to all factions that can pay them in gold and food at their respective world holdings.

[*] Arach spiders are looking for more action, and will now sell their services to food-based factions at nests and hives

[*] Added new units for recruitment at hamlets, villages, towns and cities by factions with access to generic humans (Mercia, United Tribes, Scaleborne). Catapult, Healer, Priest and Battle Priest are now available options at the largest settlements.

[*] Added new unit Farm Settler. He can set up a new farm out in the world, and can be recruited by all factions with access to human recruits in villages, towns and cities.

[*] Added new unit Engineer. He can construct guard towers and trading stations out in the world, and can be recruited in towns and cities by Mercia, United Tribes and Scaleborne.

[*] The Returned gained the ritual spell Desecrate Grounds on some of their commanders. This ritual will convert a farm into unholy grounds, which yields income they need and has recruitment options for them.
[/list]

[u]General[/u]

[list]
[*] Added desire for AI to keep building stronger and stronger armies in anticipation of late game battles. They have also learned to build leaner and more effective armies, recomposing them and switching out ineffective units and formation rows with higher quality units.

[*] Added understanding for the AI to min-max with artifacts it finds. Generally placing defensive and combat summon items on frontline units, while preferring to put +range and +dmg items on archers and ranged units.

[*] Added option to turn off summon visualizations.

[*] Added zoom in/out hotkeys to PageUp/PageDown. These can be reconfigured under options.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where having many commanders on one tile and clicking the grouping icon, would snap you back to the top.

[*] Fixed an issue causing units with the Spawner trait to spawn units into the garrison instead of under its own command.

[*] Fixed an issue where units with the Flying trait would not correctly stop when running into enemy armies during multi-tile movement.

[*] Fixed an issue where setting multi-tile paths into fog of war and then canceling them would give a red final movement arrow. This gave information on enemy fog of war movement that should not be available.

[*] Fixed a rare issue where one of your armies could disappear from the world map until you cycled back to it or moved it. This was a visual bug only and had no impact on gameplay.
[/list]

notes.title: Godking Patch - The AI Awakens
notes.content:
[i]This update brings our most meaningful AI improvement yet, with the introduction of our awareness and strategic systems. A lot of work remains before it is working perfectly, but we have taken a big step forward.

We have also added more sounds, replaced most music tracks and added a ton of new content to Godking.

We hope you are enjoying the game![/i]

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] AI is now fully aware of enemy armies it encounters in the world, and will flee from strong enemies or perform attacks of opportunity on any scouts or weaker armies it finds. Spy cats and doom bats are sad about this, as it makes the world a lot more dangerous to explore.

[*] AI is now able to build and operate multiple armies, synchronizing goals and using these armies in unison. This is a significant milestone for the AI, and has made them much stronger players.

[*] AI has gotten a lot better at defending their territories. They will now increase their defenses based on how threatened they feel, and will intercept invaders with their armies or pull armies into their HQ if things look dire. They are able to use teleport rituals and scrolls to get home in time, if these are available options.

[*] Unit icons are now pre-generated outside the game, making UI elements such as faction select screens load smoother.

[*] Added overhead text and sound effect for when combat is initiated, to make it clearer for new players that combat is resolved when you end your turn, instead of instantly.

[*] Replaced most temporary music tracks with their longer and more finalized versions from our composer Fernando.

[*] Added many new game and UI sounds to the game, such as when a new game turn starts, when speeding up battles to x4 and beyond, when picking up a treasure chest, and more.

[*] Added a notification for when trying to move an army that is out of movement points.
[/list]

[u]Content[/u]
[list]
[*] The Imperatus economy has been adjusted slightly, with some stronger units now costing less gold and mana, but more food. This has helped, and Imperatus now feels more balanced and intuitive to play as a result.

[*] Most Imperatus units got a huge visual overhaul, making them stand out more from each other and fitting the scavenger theme better.

[*] Added minor NPC faction Kovenant. A sect of necromancers willing to work for any faction that can pay them in gold and food. They can be found lurking around many unholy sites and holdings.

[*] Added minor NPC faction Dark Hand to the game. These mercenary undead wraiths are willing to work with The Returned and Imperatus. They can be recruited at Unholy Grounds, Old Graveyards and Mausoleums. 

[*] Added minor NPC faction Medawi Tribe to the game. This is a small faction of camel riding desert nomads, willing to sell their services at Oasis and Desert Temples to all factions except Khaoset and the Returned.

[*] Blackbogs can now recruit some faction units in captured goblin holdings.

[*] Imperatus can now recruit some faction units in captured goblin holdings.

[*] Khaoset can now recruit some faction units in captured Chaos Stone holdings.

[*] Scaleborne now has access to human recruits in human holdings such as villages, towns and cities, same as Mercia and United Tribes.

[*] Minor NPC faction Blood Barons had several units missing their Block traits.

[*] Reduced amount of resources gained from treasure chests. They remain rewarding, but had more direct strategic impact than intended. 

[*] Added 12 new random encounters to the world. Many of these will join player and AI factions.

[*] With our newest playable faction Imperatus added last week, our content effort has been focused on adding more general content to the game, such as more random encounter variety and more recruitment options on holdings out in the world.

[*] Adding more and more interesting world recruitment options is a direction we like a lot for the game, and we will be expanding greatly on this moving forward.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing the “click button” sound to play twice, when starting a new game.

[*] Fixed an issue causing recruiting a new commander to not correctly update the number of commanders left in the command cycle.

[*] Fixed an issue causing enemy units to be displayed in the Manage Army UI, when combat was initiated. This had no gameplay impact, but it felt a bit out of place.
[/list]

notes.title: Godking: Master of Rituals - New player faction - Imperatus!
notes.content:
[i]The mighty Imperatus have arrived! A faction of fast spreading and scavenging ratlings who specialize in necromantic bonecraft, poisonous plaguecraft and blast powder explosives. 

We think they are a lot of fun to play, and are excited to hear what you think.

We also added a number of updates and fixes to the game today, taking us another big step forward with Godking:[/i]

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Added red danger indicators for when moving into a tile will result in combat, and green indicators for when independants will join you. This has made the world map a lot easier to read at a glance.

[*] Added colored arrow movement markers when setting multi-tile paths. Green for the tiles you will move through this turn, grey for all following turns. If the last tile initiates an attack, it will be colored red. 

[*] Added auto-stop for armies that discover new enemies when using multi-tile and multi-turn pathing. Your armies will stop and give back manual control if they discover a new enemy army in or along their path, allowing you to make adjustments if needed.

[*] Added randomization of unit idle animations to battles. A small change with a nice visual impact.

[*] Added UI sounds to most actions in the game. This is the first step and there is tuning left that will happen over the next few weeks, but we are already very happy with how it lifts Godking to new heights. 

[*] Added ambient sounds to the world and battlemaps. Similar to the UI sounds, this new addition has worked out really well, and makes the world come much more alive than before.

[*] Added volume sliders for sound effects and ambient sounds under options. We recommend keeping these relatively low for now, until we can get everything smoothed out and tuned.

[*] Added button to access Manage Armies to holding/recruitment UI. Also added direct access to manage Armies by right-clicking any commander on the world map with the mouse. This makes it quicker to access for players that prefer to play with a mouse only, and much easier to find for new players.
[/list]

[u]Content[/u]
[list]
[*] Added new player faction Imperatus to the game. These ratling scavengers bring 40 new units to Eliador and specialize in necromantic and plague based magic, giving them combat spells that fear, blind and poison enemies. 

[*] Added new incarnation Bonerat Emperor to the game. This formerly influential ratling monarch has returned from his grave to lead and rule once more. He has a powerful area of effect fear spell that will send enemies fleeing, and he can summon a variety of units that can all enter water tiles with him.

[*] Re-added 14 currency giving artifacts to the game. These can be found all over Eliador.

[*] Added two new wandering encounters to the game, which will both join Imperatus players.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing defenders on walls to not correctly get a temporary bonus to their army power score. This is now added into the calculation and reflected on the tooltip power score sum of garrisons behind a wall.

[*] Fixed an issue where manually clicking through armies would not correctly take commanders out of the command rotation cycle (SPACE), causing you to have to cycle through them one more time before you could end the turn. This would make turns take longer than needed, and could feel frustrating if you play this way

[*] Fixed an issue where surrendering the game and going back to the main menu could cause an exception

[*] Fixed an issue where not having enough a resource to build a holding upgrade, would display the wrong resource missing in the notification window
[/list]

[i]While we are continuing our usual “forward in all directions” development strategy, a lot of our attention is currently on improving the AI so it becomes a more challenging opponent. We are in the process of adding an improved awareness layer for it, and so far results are very promising. 

Hope you are enjoying the game! We will be back soon with more. Feel free to join us on Discord if you haven’t already. We absolutely love talking about Godking, and would like to chat to more of you :)


Team Sensiga[/i]

notes.title: Godking: Master of Rituals - Patch April 28th
notes.content:
[i]After a little over a week of development, we are back with another update to Godking and with news about our next playable faction.

We are encouraged and grateful for all the positive feedback, and seeing that many are already getting into 50+ hours played is amazing. We will keep building Godking as fast as we can.

The Imperatus - a faction of hyper-aggressive scavenging ratlings that specialize in plaguecraft, necromancy, fear and nest burrowing - are coming to Eliador very soon, most likely next week. We have had them in development for a while and we are excited to introduce them as our seventh playable Godking faction.

In the meantime, here are the patch notes for todays build:[/i]


[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Added a hotly requested feature: multi-tile and multi-turn movement to the game. This has been mentioned by many, and we heard you. It works really well and it feels great to get it added to the game. Right click anywhere already explored to calculate and set a path, then right click again (or press space) to start moving there. We currently only display one pathing indicator color, but will upgrade this with turn specific coloring soon, so that you have more movement information available before you make decisions. Moving has been added to the Order UI cycle, so clicking that or pressing SPACE to progress movement works great.

[*] Left or right clicking the mouse outside UI such as Unit Inspect UI or Manage Armies UI will now close the window. This makes it easier to play the game with a mouse only.

[*] Added UI buttons to close battlemaps and combat summaries with mouse only.

[*] AI now understands how to use ritual spells to transmute units into stronger units. This has in particular helped Khaoset and Mercian AI players perform better.

[*] AI will now use faction commanders more actively on the map, often bringing them with their main armies. This improves their overall ability to replenish armies out in the field instead of having to go back to the HQ constantly. As a result most AI factions now expand faster, often outperforming veteran players early game.

[*] AI will now actively pick up treasure chests. Before we felt it was more fun to mostly save them for players. This almost always put the AI behind after a while, so we felt it was more fair if they got an equal chance at chests as the player. As a result some AI factions can pull significantly ahead now, if they happen to get a particularly lucky starting position. 
[/list]

[i]As far as AI goes, we feel we have only scratched the surface and we have big plans. We are working on upgraded awareness and strategic layers for the AI, and these will be introduced in small steps over the coming weeks. Savour this happy to just expand and act relatively peaceful AI - it is getting smarter and more aggressive every patch.[/i]


[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where playing with mouse only and clicking the Order UI manually instead of pressing the SPACE shortcut, would sometimes cause the wrong order information to be displayed. The correct order would be performed, but not displaying the right text

[*] Fixed an issue where spam-right clicking certain resource generating ritual spells (to set auto-cast), would let the ritual be cast as often as you could bother to click it, generating resources every time. This was a semi-exploit only, as the unit would still correctly be charged action points for each cast, essentially sending it into crippling time-depth

[*] Fixed an issue causing flying units to stand directly on top of other units on the battlefield, instead of hovering over them in the air. It’s a cool feature that fliers can share a tile with a ground unit, and now it looks as you’d expect too

[*] Fixed an issue causing spell effects to show up for a split second as you load into a battle. This was leftover effects from AI battles happening elsewhere, just before your battle started

[*] Fixed an issue causing movement cost to be displayed on tooltip for a tile, even if your active selection could not enter it

[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to switch artifacts between units in battle

[*] Fixed an issue where an immortal unit dying in battle, would not correctly play its death animation

[*] Fixed an issue where treasure chest beams were a bit too intense on the world map
[/list]

[i]In addition to this we performed a number of little art micro-improvements all across the game, lifting us a tiny bit closer to the ultimate vision for Godking.

We will be back with more soon. Thanks again for all the support, and look out for incoming ratlings![/i]


[i]Team Sensiga[/i]

notes.title: Godking: Master of Rituals - Patch April 17th
notes.content:
We are one day early with our planned weekend patch, but decided there was no point in waiting - so here it is!


[u]General[/u]

[list]
[*] Implemented fade in/out effect when armies move on world map - this has reduced a previously noticeable “popping” effect, and gives the game a more polished feel

[*] Added projectile tracers during combat! This makes it clearer and easier to follow the action, and we think it looks pretty fantastic. More combat beautifying and improving on the way

[*] Camera center on commander, on move - now default off. Added toggle under general options for those that want it on. This was pointed out and requested by many players, and it is great to finally get it supported

[*] World map generation tuning: We lowered the overall chance for swamps and forest tiles on the world map. Grasslands and other 1 move cost tiles are now more common. This makes traveling the map faster, and introduces more opportunity for picking optimal paths
 
[*] Accessibility upgrade: Incarnation and starting faction commander are now grouped by default when starting a new game - gentle heads up if you already internalized the old non-grouped setup. By clicking the small white grouping button you can select/deselect grouped commanders

[*] Combat summons (temporary units) are now included in the combat summary after a battle, but with unit icon borders in a different color

[*] Added last round of world map LOD optimization round. This will make the game run faster on older hardware

[*] Adjusted Commander UI so it is aligned with Active Selection UI. We think this looks a bit nicer and cleaner than before

[*] AI world map pathfinding improvement added, making the AI better at maneuvering the world optimally. This overall makes the AI slightly more effective than before
[/list]

[u]Content[/u]

[list]
[*] Feral Lizardman Stoner summoned by Frozen Tidemancer incarnation and sometimes found wandering out in the wild, has been moved from frontline to front support like the Scaleborne faction version
[/list]


[u]Fixes[/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with commander plates and Army Management button pushed off screen if too many commanders on a tile. Now also with slider, if needed

[*] Fixed an issue causing units to only regenerate 1 hitpoint between game turns, instead of 10% of its max health. Large health units are very happy about this fix, and will now be ready for action again faster after combat

[*] Fixed a tooltip issue where wandering monsters and holding garrisons willing to join you would say “Can join”. Changed to “Will join” as they always join if you walk into their tile

[*] Fixed an issue where shortcut to Manage Armies (r) was listed as Transfer Armies under keyboard bindings

[*] Fixed an issue where playing in 4K would make world map holdings disappear for some players. We would like to hear back from 4K players if issues persist after this fix

[*] Fixed an issue where buying a holding upgrade with lots of units and unlocks, would sometimes overlap itself in the Notification window

[*] Fixed an issue where getting eliminated by the AI (losing your HQ and being banished), would sometimes cause an exception

[*] Fixed an issue where losing the game would not let you see and inspect the entire map as a consolation prize

[*] Fixed an issue where summoning animation during ritual spells, was playing the basic attack of the unit instead of its spell animation

[*] Fixed an issue where ingame Credits screen could only be exited with ESC
[/list]

notes.title: Godking: Master of Rituals - Major Content Update #1
notes.content:
This is our first significant content update since early access launch one week ago.

We want to keep a high tempo and continue building the game as fast as we can. We will keep these content boosters coming.

We are experimenting with extensive patch notes this time. It’s a lot to read and some may prefer to find these changes and additions on their own by exploring the game, instead of getting it spoiled here.

Early Saturday there will be a new patch with bug fixes, new features, optimizations and ui improvements to the game.

Thanks and hope you are enjoying the game!


[u]General Updates[/u]
[list]
[*] AI combat spell decision making has been improved for caster units, with better target picking. Spellcasters are now less likely to pick targets outside their range (thus needing to move), and less likely to hit allies with friendly fire aoe spells. It is always risky to bring area of effect damage spells to a fight, but now slightly less so. This update makes spellcasters very effective in performing their various roles in battle.
[/list]

[u]Incarnations[/u]


[b]High Shaman[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new ritual spell Summon Wolven Fenrir - the Wolven Fenrir is a strong close combat werewolf commander with the Undying trait, so as long as you win the battle you get him back even if he dies. The ideal friend for the High Shaman to roam around in werewolf form with
[*] Summon Wolven Guard ritual spell sacred herb cost reduced from 16 to 10 - summoning lesser werewolves was not an effective use of limited resources. This will help make the spell see more use
[*] Ancestral Wereform ritual spell sacred herb cost reduced from 24 to 18 - turning into a werewolf and running around terrorizing the countryside feels very rewarding. We are making it cheaper, so the High Shaman can jump between human and werewolf form more often
[/list]

[b]Older Earthmother[/b]
[list]
[*] Call Animal Allies summoning ritual results slightly improved, making it overall more valuable to cast
[*] Summon Lesser Stone Golem cost reduced from sacred herb 22 to 20
[/list]

[i]The Older Earthmother is currently considered one of the weaker Incarnations by our community. We are planning more help for her, but these changes make her a better strategic summoner and overall slightly stronger.[/i]


[b]Wraith Lord[/b]
[list]
[*] Wraith Lord got updated model visuals - from wearing old dirty rags to having a more epic look fitting an undead Godking candidate
[/list]

[b]Harbinger of Chaos[/b]
[list]
[*] Both Reaver ritual spell summons have been given humanoid (full) item slots. This makes using artifacts with his self made armies easier. It also makes him stronger as a direct result
[/list]

[u]Player Factions[/u]


[b]Mercia[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new unit Mercian Hellfire Warhulk - an elite siege unit that can move faster on the world map than most other siege units Mercia has access to
[*] Mercian Heavy Cavalry got +1 armor to be more comparable to other human heavy cavalry
[/list]

[i]We feel Mercia is in a really good place. They have no apparent weakness and they are resistant to even an especially unlucky start. They have a large range of units and viable options, and we feel Mercia is the faction all other factions need to measure against. Right now they stand as a class of their own.[/i]


[b]Blackbog Goblins[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new unit Blackbog Spiderknight - a fast forest goblin mercenary riding a spider and armed with lance and shield. It is unlocked by the Spider Catching upgrade
[*] Gather Slave Troops summoning ritual has been toned down. For 1 food and some AP, it is still very cost effective and can give up to six slaves on a good roll. To compensate somewhat for these changes, the AP cost has been changed from 3 to 2, allowing two potential casts in a round
[*] Advanced Slavecraft ritual spell has been normalized, with a higher guaranteed minimum, and a lower maximum potential. Despite this semi-nerf, this is still one of the most cost effective rituals in the game at the moment
[*] Added new high level ritual spell Slavecraft Mastery. This spell can yield ogres, dark ogres, forest goblin Spiderknights and Witchen support healers
[*] Blackbog Dark Queen gained new ritual spell Slavecraft Mastery
[*] Ogres available for the Blackbogs to recruit in ogre holdings out in the world, have been made overall cheaper. The ogre commanders have been made significantly cheaper
[*] Ogre Hexworker and Ogre Spellworker mage commanders are now available for recruitment in Ogre Caveborgs for currently Blackbogs only. Ogre holding recruitment is under consideration for more factions
[*] Ogre holding max recruitment caps increased from 1 to 2 for Ogre Stonespike Camp and from 1 to 3 for Ogre Caveborgs
[*] Fixed incorrect Spider Slaveling AP from 3 to 4
[*] Blackbog Dark Queen now requires Spider Catching upgrade to unlock
[*] Blackbog Dark Queen recruitment gold cost reduced from 42 to 38, a small discount to reflect that she now needs the Spider Catching upgrade to be available
[/list]

[i]The Blackbogs are strong. Most of their early game strength comes from the enormous amount of cheap slaves they can generate, their ninja spy cat scouts that give excellent cheap vision and scouting power. For late game once their economy is running well, they can transition into ogres and caster commanders with enslave spells, and no one likes fighting those.[/i]


[b]United Tribes[/b]
[list]
[*] United Tribes now starts with a Barbarian Ritualist commander instead of the previous chieftain. This makes their early game stronger, and gives them access to their totem based economy option faster
[*] Added new holding upgrade Trade Agreement: Iron - with a new guaranteed source of iron income, the barbarians are less dependent on lucking into iron to access their advanced units early
[*] Barbarian Beastmaster ritual spell Ceremony of The Moon casting cost reduced from sacred herb 12 to 9, making it more cost effective
[*] Panzer bear recruitment costs reduced dramatically - Panzer bears can be recruited from their various world holdings by United Tribes. They are strong but still expensive, and now a more viable end game strategy for the barbarians
[*] Panzer bear recruitment per turn caps have been increased from 1 to 2 at Panzer Bear Outpost, and from 1 to 3 at Panzer Bear Stronghold - this makes it easier to recruit large numbers of bears
[*] Panzer Bear Ancestralite caster commanders now available at Panzer Bear Strongholds for United Tribes
[*] Barbarian Sorceror (sic - barbaric spelling!) gained Remove Conditions combat spell
[*] Barbarian Sorceror ritual spell Call of The Ancestors sacred herb casting cost reduced from 22 to 18, making it easier to build a ghost army sooner
[*] Barbarian Axethrower recruitment gold cost reduced from 4 to 3, to make it a more competitive choice versus the barbarian skirmisher
[*] Barbarian Duelist food recruitment cost reduced from 3 to 2
[*] Barbarian Duelist has been rebalanced so he hopefully becomes a more interesting alternative in barbarian armies. His dodge skill has been improved, and he now attacks twice per round although with reduced damage per attack
[*] Barbarian Shield Master has been made slightly cheaper to recruit, and has gained +2 hitpoints. This makes it a more cost effective unit, with improved durability
[/list]

[i]The United Tribes has had the misfortune of being regarded as the weakest faction currently in the game. We think these changes and additions will make them both a bit more competitive with other playable factions, but also they feel more intuitive and more fun to play now. We would like to hear what you think about the barbarians with these new changes in place.[/i]


[b]Scaleborne[/b]
[list]
[*] Combat Shaman gained Remove Conditions combat spell
[*] Horned Priestess gained Remove Conditions combat spell
[*] Feral Lizard Stoner has moved from a front to a front support position. This makes them easier to keep alive and overall more effective in lizardman armies
[/list]

[i]Scaleborne is fun to play, and they feel reasonably resistant to a bad starting position. They are a food intensive faction, but you can get a food economy going with them by creating Lightning Serpent Stones. These give +1 food and double as stationary defenders. Lizardmen armies are small but durable - with good defenses and tons of healing. Being able to slip in and out of the water is a massive strategic advantage for them. They are no Mercia, but they can hold their own and feel overall balanced.[/i]


[b]The Returned[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new ritual spell Raise Tribunus Militum. This will summon one out of two non-mage commanders, either the Bone Captain or the mounted Decurion. Both are useful for ferrying items or troops, or as cheap scouts on the world map. They have in turn been removed from the more expensive ritual spell Raise Legatus, as it felt like an unlucky result for such a high soul cost. The new ritual can be cast by the Nekrosage starting commander, as well as by the Lord Strategus
[*] Raise Equites ritual spell cost reduced from 8 souls to 6
[*] Raise Legatus will now only give caster commanders, and the two non-caster commanders that felt disappointing to get, have been moved to a new cheaper ritual summon called Raise Tribunus Militum
[/list]

[i]The Returned got an extensive balance and quality of life pass this week. Some of the randomness to the faction has been limited, ritual spell tooltips have been updated with more accurate information of what to expect, and some of the weaker commanders have gotten their own cheaper ritual spell to summon them, instead of showing up as underwhelming high cost results. The Returned now feel stronger and less at the mercy of random results, but we would love to hear what you think of them. We suspect they still need some help to be comparable to stronger factions such as Mercia and the Blackbog Goblins.[/i]


[b]Khaoset[/b]
[list]
[*] All versions of the Reaver line of mutations now have humanoid (all) artifact slots. This is both a big quality of life and power boost improvement as they now can take a more active part in the artifact min-max game, and gear up armies much more freely
[/list]

[u]Other Content[/u]


[b]Artifacts[/b]
[list]
[*] Added rare artifact Divine Breastplate
[*] Added common artifact Ring of Heroism
[*] Added rare artifact Ghost King’s Robe
[*] Added common artifact Ring of Water Walking
[*] Added uncommon artifact Water Breathing Helmet
[*] Added common artifact Snow Shoes
[*] Added common artifact Swamp Hag Boots
[*] Added rare artifact Ritualist Boots
[*] Added rare artifact Bear Shaman’s Necklace
[*] Added rare artifact Serpent Amulet
[*] Added very rare Wartroll Guardian Amulet 
[*] Added rare consumable artifact Creator Soul
[*] Added rare artifact Nimble Ring of Initiative
[*] Superb Ring of Quickness gave -1 initiative, now improved to -2 initiative. Lower initiative is better, as you get to act sooner in combat
[*] Obediah's Heart consumable artifact has been moved from rare to common drop chance
[*] Visionary Helmet now gives Scouting trait instead of +1 mana, as that feels more appropriate for the name
[/list]

[i]We added a good batch of new artifacts this week. Three of these give the holder the Combat Spawner trait, which summons one or more free units at the start of combat. The Wartroll Amulet is especially epic, giving you a free essentially immortal wartroll every battle. Combat spawner items are usually best placed on center frontline units, so the free summons get straight into battle.[/i]


[b]Independents[/b]
[list]
[*] New wandering encounter Elven Hunting Party
[*] New wandering encounter Blackrose Platoon
[*] Panzer Bear Ravager now has a cleave attack, potentially hitting up to three enemies at once
[*] Panzer Bear Ancestralite and Panzer Bear Linebreaker have shields, but were missing Block traits. Also given +1 AC each to reflect carrying large shields.
[*] Neutral humans offering their services in cities and holdings with recruitment options for Mercia and United Tribes, will now ask for a minimum of 2 food to join, in addition to any gold cost.
[*] Veteran Swordsman was missing Block trait. Now has 25% chance to block attacks
[*] Scout was missing arrow projectile
[*] Battle Priest gained Remove Conditions combat spell
[*] Panzer Bear Shaman gained Remove Conditions combat spell
[*] Elven Spellsinger gained Remove Conditions combat spell
[*] Gaian Lifematron gained Remove Conditions combat spell
[*] Quanta Lifebringer gained Remove Conditions combat spell
[/list]


These changes are now live - Next patch coming Saturday!

notes.title: Early Access +1 Day - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for all the feedback and support! Godking has a growing and already amazing community, and we are having a lot of fun talking to you about the game. We are getting great ideas and suggestions, and we are blown away by how fast so many of you are picking up on the strategies and calculations involved in playing the game, and already coming up with new strategies and ways to play.

Godking has been live for just over 24 hours, but so far so good! There have been no full crashes reported so far, and the issues found are not keeping anyone from playing the game.

Our immediate attention is on getting reported issues fixed, so the game plays as smooth as it can. This includes a continued effort to optimize so it runs better - especially on older hardware. Next step is expanding on content and continuing improving the AI, so it becomes an increasingly challenging opponent, capable of giving even veteran players a tough fight. 

Some of the next AI steps are teaching it how to use some of the more advanced ritual spells, teaching it to respond better to a full invade, teaching it how to panic defend when panic is the appropriate response - and we are debating whether we should let the AI “see” treasure chests again. We have tried it before, and it tended to give them nasty armies too soon!

We are excited about our plans for the AI moving forward. We have built fantastic tools that let us closely observe everything it does, and the reasoning and strategizing behind it. We believe this observer mode will help us train it to expert levels within a relatively short time frame. It is already entertaining to sit back and watch it play on its own, so we have talked about making this an actual feature at one point.

Much to do, but we are FINALLY on the way. We are super pumped, and will keep the patches and updates coming.

We are very approachable and love to talk about all things Godking, so feel free to join us on Discord or talk to us here on Steam!

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Added a fade out/fade in to summoning visualization and when inspecting (double left clicking) a tile. This makes both sequences feel smoother.

[*] Added credits screen to the main menu, with shoutouts to members of the community for all their help. Thanks a ton guys! We will keep immortalizing you all in tiny places all around the game, as we really enjoy doing that
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where buying the first Khaoset holding upgrade would misalign parts of the holding ui. This was an issue that fixed itself next time you opened the same ui, but Khaoset wasn’t amused

[*] Fixed an issue where skipping to the end of a battle [Q] during the exact moment a damage calculation was being made, could cause an exception and make the log window appear. This did not break the game, and hitting Clear would close the window and resume the game as normal

[*] Fixed an issue where equipping an artifact on a unit, could sometimes accidentally replace another artifact, causing that item to be lost
[/list]


[i]Team Sensiga[/i]

notes.title: Godking: Master of Rituals - Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Welcome to Godking: Master of Rituals early access!

We are incredibly happy and relieved we are finally here. It feels surreal and humbling - but mostly it feels really good.

First we have to thank our friends, family and beta testers for all their help. We would not have gotten here without you, and we won’t forget. Thanks a ton to all of you!

Second a gentle warning: This is an early access release day, and chances are there could be issues. We recommend waiting a few days if you want to guarantee yourself the most smooth impression of early Godking you can get.

With that out of the way - there are no illusions here. We know we have just completed a massive milestone, but we are also aware that this is when the real work begins. We are ready to react to problems, and we are excited and motivated to pour all we got into making Godking the best 4X fantasy strategy game it can be. 

Over the next few days we will focus on making the game as stable and problem free as possible, and making sure no one is prevented from playing. We also want to make sure it runs super smooth, even on older hardware.

Going forward we will work with our community on the direction of the game. These are the first baby steps of what Godking can be, and we can’t wait to keep expanding on it. Forward in all directions!

And this is where we would love to hear from you. What would you like to see more of? What kind of playable factions would you like to see in the game? Elves? Dwarves? Or maybe a ratling faction? Or how about a faction of werewolves, or undead floating wraiths? Or some kind of vampire faction? A faction of ethereal ghosts? A playable faction of spider priests and mages.. Could that be fun?

We would also love to hear your thoughts on the topic of multiplayer for Godking. Is this something our players really want? Or would you prefer more focus on general game content and more and more ruthlessly efficient AI players?

Let us know, and we hope you enjoy the game! 


[i]Team Sensiga[/i]

notes.title: Godking: Master of Rituals
notes.content:
[i]Less than five days till early access release, so we are working hard to make sure the game is in the best shape it can be![/i]

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Scrolling ui by hovering over it and using the mouse wheel has been sped up. This makes the feature smoother to use across the game.

[*] When a commander is already at his faction HQ, all “teleport back to HQ” spells and scrolls will be grayed out and unusable, until the commander leaves.

[*] Added a scrollbar for holdings with exceptionally full holding ui - such as a late game HQ, with lots of recruitment options, holding upgrades and dozens of garrisoned units.
[/list]

[u]Content[/u]
[list]
[*] Added new NPC factions the Revolution - a group of human revolutionaries with dangerous new ideas, and the Forest Goblins - famous for their Spiderknights and Witchen healers. These can now be found defending holdings or wandering around the world in small groups. In total this update brings about a dozen new units to Eliador - the Godking world.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the holding ui top box would leave a blank space when inspecting enemy holdings.

[*] Fixed an issue where a consumable artifact found after winning a battle, could cause an exception.

[*] Fixed an issue where a combat summoned unit (temporary for this battle only unit) could end up on top of a wall.

[*] Fixed an issue where purchasing holding upgrades, would display a placeholder icon instead of the correct one

[*] Fixed an issue where enemy army power score on hover-over tooltip would say “Army Power”. It now says “Enemy Power”, making it clearer what you are looking at.

[*] Fixed an issue where the battle summary screen would say the player had lost a battle, even if he actually won. This was a display issue only, and did not affect the game directly.

[*] Fixed a world map camera issue, where it would sometimes think you were at the edge of the map when you were not.

[*] Fixed a world map camera issue, where on loading a large map it would sometimes misalign the camera
[/list]

notes.title: Godking: Master of Rituals
notes.content:
Hi guys,

We just published a new patch for our testers, getting one step closer to ready for early access. We will start posting these every time there is a new patch from now on :)

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*] Units on world map will now be less obscured/hidden by trees and other world map objects. This makes the world map a lot easier to read at a glance

[*] The world map has been optimized with more LODs - lower quality versions of holdings for when zoomed far out. This will help the game run better on older hardware

[*] When picking a faction on the faction select screen, the incarnation select screen will now open with the thematic suggestion for that faction first

[*] There are now tooltips when hovering over units on the combat summary screen, making it consistent with the rest of the game

[*] Added a Delete button to the Save/Load screens, making it easier to delete old saves
[/list]

[u]Content[/u]
[list]
[*] New Incarnation: The Godwyrm of Fire - this is an incredibly powerful incarnation choice, capable of winning the game almost alone with little help from its faction. It is Godking on easy mode, but it is a lot of fun! Mercia is perhaps the most thematic pick for the Godwyrm, but anything works with it. It is a bit like having an Apache attack helicopter on turn 1, while the enemy still has bows.
[/list]

[u]Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where AI players could pick up and wander around with units that have the Stationary trait. These units are not supposed to be able to be moved by walking, and it could make the Khaoset ai player especially difficult to deal with

[*] Fixed an issue where pausing combat would always take you back to x1 playback speed. It will now unpause at the playback speed you already selected

[*] Fixed an issue where picking up a chest with no resources in it (only artifacts), would still display an empty resource notification

[*] Fixed a bug where Attacks would always say 1 when inspecting units, even if they had the Haste trait

[*] Fixed a bug where scrolling the mouse over UI to move the scrollbar, would also change the zoom of the world camera
[/list]
